api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Journal Entries: List Journal Entries

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports JournalName, Status, LedgerId, PeriodName, Source, Category, CreatedBy, BatchName. Example: q=PeriodName='Apr-24' and Status='Posted'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, attachments, approvals
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves journal entries across accounting periods. Filter by ledger, period, source, or posting status.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Journal Entries: Get a Journal Entry

api_arguments.JournalHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the journal entry header.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, attachments, approvals
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a journal entry including all debit and credit lines with account segment values.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Journal Entries: Create a Journal Entry

api_arguments.JournalName: [REQUIRED] string: Name of the journal entry.
api_arguments.AccountingDate: [REQUIRED] string: Accounting date for the journal. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.CurrencyCode: [REQUIRED] string: Currency of the journal. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.Description: string: Description of the journal entry.
api_arguments.ReferenceDate: string: Optional reference date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Journal lines array. Each line requires AccountCombination (segment string like '01.000.1200.000'), EnteredDebit or EnteredCredit amount, and optionally Description and TaxCode.

functionality: Creates a journal entry with debit and credit lines for a specified ledger and accounting period.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Journal Entries: Post a Journal Entry

api_arguments.JournalHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the journal entry to post.

functionality: Posts an approved journal entry to the general ledger, updating account balances.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Journal Entries: Reverse a Journal Entry

api_arguments.JournalHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the journal entry to reverse.
api_arguments.ReversalPeriodName: [REQUIRED] string: Accounting period in which to post the reversal. Example: 'May-24'.
api_arguments.ReversalDate: string: Accounting date for the reversal. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to first day of the reversal period.
api_arguments.ReversalMethod: string: Reversal method. Valid values: SWITCH_DR_CR (switch debits and credits), CHANGE_SIGN (change sign of amounts). Default: SWITCH_DR_CR.

functionality: Creates and posts a reversal of a previously posted journal entry in a specified period.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Account Balances: Get Account Balances

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LedgerId, PeriodName, AccountCombination, CurrencyCode, BalanceType. Example: q=LedgerId=300000001234567 and PeriodName='Apr-24' and BalanceType='PTD'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return. Example: 'AccountCombination,PeriodName,PeriodToDateDebit,PeriodToDateCredit,PeriodToDateBalance'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves general ledger account balances for a specific period and ledger. Supports period-to-date, quarter-to-date, and year-to-date balance types.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Ledgers: List Ledgers

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LedgerName, LedgerShortName, CurrencyCode, PeriodSetName, Status. Example: q=Status='Active'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves ledgers defined in Oracle Financials, including primary and secondary ledgers with their chart of accounts and calendar.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Accounting Periods: List Accounting Periods

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LedgerId, PeriodName, PeriodStatus, StartDate, EndDate. Example: q=LedgerId=300000001234567 and PeriodStatus='Open'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves accounting periods and their current status (Open, Closed, Future Enterable) for a ledger.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Accounting Periods: Open or Close a Period

api_arguments.PeriodId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the accounting period.
api_arguments.PeriodStatus: [REQUIRED] string: Target status for the period. Valid values: Open, Closed, Permanently Closed.

functionality: Opens or closes an accounting period for a ledger. Closing a period prevents further journal entry posting.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Chart of Accounts: List Account Combinations

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LedgerId, Company, CostCenter, Account, SubAccount, Product, Enabled. Example: q=Company='01' and Account='1200' and Enabled='Y'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves valid account combinations from the chart of accounts. Use this to look up active GL code combinations before creating journal lines.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Account Combinations: Create an Account Combination

api_arguments.StartDateActive: string: Date from which the combination is active. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.EndDateActive: string: Date after which the combination is inactive. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Enabled: string: Whether the combination is enabled. Valid values: Y, N. Default: Y.

functionality: Creates a new account combination in the chart of accounts for use in journal entries and distributions.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Budget Journals: Create a Budget Journal

api_arguments.PeriodName: [REQUIRED] string: Accounting period for the budget amount. Example: 'Apr-24'.
api_arguments.AccountCombination: [REQUIRED] string: Full account segment string. Example: '01.000.5100.000'.
api_arguments.BudgetAmount: [REQUIRED] number: Budget amount to load. Use positive for increase, negative for decrease.
api_arguments.CurrencyCode: [REQUIRED] string: Currency code for the budget amount. Example: 'USD'.
api_arguments.BudgetEntryType: string: How to apply the budget. Valid values: ENTERED (add to existing), BALANCE (replace existing). Default: ENTERED.

functionality: Creates a budget journal to load or adjust budget amounts for a specific account and period.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Financial Reports: Run a Financial Report

api_arguments.ReportId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the Financial Reporting (FR) report to run.
api_arguments.LedgerId: [REQUIRED] integer: Ledger for which to run the report.
api_arguments.OutputFormat: string: Output format. Valid values: PDF, EXCEL, HTML. Default: PDF.
api_arguments.PointOfView: array: Array of POV dimension-member pairs to override default POV values. Example: [{"dimension": "Scenario", "member": "Budget"}]

functionality: Runs a Financial Reporting report and returns the output in the specified format.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Intercompany Transactions: List Intercompany Transactions

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports TransactionNumber, Status, InitiatingLedgerId, RecipientLedgerId, TransactionDate, BatchId. Example: q=Status='APPROVED'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, approvals
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves intercompany transactions between legal entities, used to eliminate intercompany balances in consolidation.

api_name: REST API for Oracle ERP General Ledger - Allocations: Run Allocation Rule

api_arguments.AllocationRuleId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the allocation rule to run.
api_arguments.PeriodName: [REQUIRED] string: Period for which to run the allocation. Example: 'Apr-24'.
api_arguments.LedgerId: [REQUIRED] integer: Ledger for which to run the allocation.
api_arguments.RunMode: string: Run mode. Valid values: DRAFT (preview without posting), FINAL (post allocation entries). Default: DRAFT.

functionality: Runs an allocation rule to distribute costs or revenue from a source account to target accounts based on predefined allocation methods.
